The '''Commenorian Navy''' was the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor's]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], and was active at the time of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. It had multiple [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[BTL-S8 K-wing assault starfighter]]s, including [[Grayfeather Squadron]].
